regions.title: Nominal Stabilization
regions.dek: How prices, exchange rates, monetary conditions, and expectations interact during Argentina's stabilization process.

regions.title: External & Financial Constraint
regions.dek: How reserves, external flows, debt obligations, market access, and the depth of domestic finance shape Argentina's capacity to absorb shocks and finance growth.

regions.title: Fiscal Regime
regions.dek: Explain revenues, spending, balances, subsidies, pensions, public financing needs, and institutional durability of the fiscal anchor.

regions.title: Household Welfare
regions.dek: Explain purchasing power, poverty, basic baskets, distribution, social benefits, and how macro/labor changes reach households.

regions.title: Labor & Incomes
regions.dek: Explain employment quantity/quality, labor formalization, wages, real earnings, informality, and labor-market transmission from sectoral change.

regions.title: Real Economy
regions.dek: Explain output, demand, investment, consumption, sectoral performance, production structure, and the real-side consequences of stabilization and openness.
